description: Gate false positives found 2026-10-06: the LinkedIn attribution LLM listed a tracked company while its own reasoning said the anchor belonged to a DIFFERENT entity (namesake fund/brand). Expected verdict for every row is NONE. Texts are fetchable by activity_id from linkedin_posts (rows are flagged misattributed=true, not deleted, so this set stays reproducible). Wire into ops/scripts/eval_li_gate_mini.mjs as negative cases.
pattern: reasoning contains a negation of the match (e.g. 'not the identity security company', 'no concrete anchor') yet companyName is set

cases.why: LUMO Labs (Dutch VC) congratulating a portfolio company; model wrote 'not the identity security company' and still attributed
seed round led by LUMO Labs
phrase 'the way security works'; model noted no concrete anchor and still attributed
Redblock Branding Solutions; shared name token only
